input.title: Offline first field app
input.pitch: A field app that never blocks when the signal drops.

evidence.text: Crews tolerate sync conflicts when the app never blocks; 18 of 40 target sessions completed offline.

output.summary: The reuse of the offline trial supports a conditional case.

factors.name: competition
factors.summary: Field tooling is crowded but offline is underserved.

factors.name: build_cost
factors.summary: Bootstrapped scope keeps the cost contained.

factors.name: time_to_market
factors.summary: The prior trial already ran in the field.

factors.name: defensibility
factors.gap: No retention evidence after the pilot.

factors.name: acquisition
factors.summary: The pilot crews are a warm channel.
